features.featureTitle: Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'pioneers-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Pioneers Report' title, and the current date; a professional table with columns for Name, Service Year, Total Hours, Average Hours, Current Status, and Monthly Hours; header/accent colors using #43587A; black text on white background; landscape orientation for the wide table.

Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'tasks-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Tasks Report' title, and the current date; a professional table with columns for Title, Due Date, Category, Status, and Notes; header/accent colors using #43587A; black text on white background; completed tasks shown with strikethrough styling.

Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'notes-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Notes Report' title, and the current date; notes organized by category with category headers styled in #43587A; each note showing its title, content, and creation date; black text on white background.
